# DEVSENSE PHP Language Server

This package provides language server for PHP.

## 🧠 Language Server

The language server is provided as a platform-specific binary executable file, located in `node_modules/devsense-php-ls-${os}-${cpu}/dist/devsense.php.ls`.

The functionality is provided to end-users under a freemium model. See _🔐 Activation_ section below for details.

## 🧬 Protocol

The language server is controlled using the Language Server Protocol according to https://microsoft.github.io/language-server-protocol/specifications/lsp/3.17/specification/ through STDIN/STDOUT.

There are several additions:

- `"initialize"` method, parameter:

```json
{
    "initializationOptions": {
        "0": "KEY or {JSON CODE}",
        "clientFeatures": [],
        // VSCode settings and their values listed on
        // https://docs.devsense.com/vscode/configuration/
        // "setting-id": "value",
    },

    // process ID of client allowing
    // LS to automatically kill itself if client exits
    "processId": 123456,
    
    // ...
}
```

## Command-Line Arguments

- `-version`, `-v`:       Prints application version information.
- `-composerNodes`:     Enable or disable composer nodes caching. Default is `true`.
- `-parallelism`:       Number of threads used for indexing and analysis. Default is the number of CPU cores * `2`.
- `-lsp-log`:           Output path to the language server protocol log.
- `-mcp`:               If specified, this language server process will also act as a Model Context Protocol Server. The server will listen on 127.0.0.1 at random available port if not specified with --mcp-server-port. The actual port number will be returned by the language server initialize response.
- `-mcp-server-port`:   Specifies the port number the MCP server will listen on. Otherwise a random available port will be used

## Enabling MCP Server

The language server process can act as [MCP Server](https://docs.devsense.com/vscode/ai/mcp/) (MCP through _http_ transport stream). This enables tools for AI agents providing semantic information about your workspace.

Start the language server process with `-mcp` and `-mcp-server-port <number>` arguments:

> devsense-php-ls -mcp -mcp-server-port 9101

_Example `mcp.json`:_

```json
{
  "servers": {
    "phptools": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:9101"
    }
  }
}
```

## 🔐 Activation

The language server provides free features and premium features which needs to be activated by end-user.

**_Note to developers:_** To unlock the premium features of this package, instruct end-users to follow the steps below:

1. **Purchase a License:**
   User needs to purchase license on official purchase page: [https://www.devsense.com/purchase](https://www.devsense.com/purchase)

2. **Activate Language Server**

   Set the value of license key into `DEVSENSE_PHP_LS_LICENSE` environment variable or `"initializationOptions"."0"`. Language Server will try to activate automatically upon starting (requires Internet connection).

3. **Optional: Offline Activation**

   In case there is no Internet connection: User will follow the link below to validate license and receive a **{JSON CODE}**: [devsense.com/purchase/validation](https://www.devsense.com/purchase/validation)

   Pass the entire `{JSON CODE}` into the language server's `initialize` method, as a `"initializationOptions"."0"` property:

   ```json
   {
     "initializationOptions": {
        "0": "{JSON CODE}",
     },
   }
   ```

   Or store the `{JSON CODE}` into environment variable `DEVSENSE_PHP_LS_LICENSE`.

---

If you encounter any issues during the activation process, please refer to our documentation or contact support.
